fields.description: Used when an item is scanned before any location has set the active warehouse.
fields.label: Default Warehouse

fields.description: Block saving a counted line whose variance is non-zero unless a reason is given.
fields.label: Require Reason for Variance

fields.description: If off, scanning a barcode that matches no Item is rejected instead of allowing a manual pick.
fields.label: Allow Unmatched Item Barcodes

fields.description: Show the camera scan button (uses the device camera where the browser supports the BarcodeDetector API).
fields.label: Enable In-Page Camera Scanning

fields.description: The /stock-scan page: technicians take parts, receivers add stock, anyone puts stock away, from a warehouse's QR label.
fields.label: Stock Scan Page

fields.description: Debited when parts are taken for a job: a technician's take on the Stock Scan page, and the consumables a Sapphire Maintenance Record issues. Used only when the item and its item group name no expense account of their own. Blank uses the company's Stock Adjustment Account, and failing that the company's only Stock Adjustment account.
fields.label: Parts Taken: Expense Account

fields.description: Credited when stock is added on the Stock Scan page without a purchase order (a Material Receipt, flagged for review). Used only when the item and its item group name no expense account of their own. Blank uses the same fallback as above.
fields.label: Added Without PO: Offset Account

fields.description: Blank uses the job's cost center when a job is chosen, else the company's default.
fields.label: Cost Center

fields.description: Off: the technician may pick a job for the run or skip it. On: every take must name one.
fields.label: Require a Job for Every Take

fields.description: How long the person who saved a scan can undo it from the page. 0 turns undo off for everyone but Stock Managers, who can always reverse a save.
fields.label: Undo Window (Minutes)

fields.description: Leave unticked. Tick it only if iPhones start asking for camera permission again on Stock Scan: it turns off the phone's Back and Forward between Stock Scan screens and in the Report a problem form, so Back leaves the page as it did before v1.534.0. Takes effect the next time the page is opened.
fields.label: Turn Off Browser Back on Stock Scan
